chosen.premise: Rain makes steam spout from Charmander’s tail, yet a healthy flame can keep burning while wet.
chosen.hook: Rain hits Charmander’s tail—and it starts steaming.
chosen.visualIdea: Raindrops strike the tail flame in slow motion, creating steam before the flame stays lit.
chosen.note: A concrete, memorable contradiction: rain creates steam, yet a healthy flame can keep burning while wet. The cited entries directly support both halves.

candidates.premise: Rain makes steam spout from Charmander’s tail, yet a healthy flame can keep burning while wet.
candidates.hook: Rain hits Charmander’s tail—and it starts steaming.
candidates.visualIdea: Raindrops strike the tail flame in slow motion, creating steam before the flame stays lit.
candidates.note: A concrete, memorable contradiction: rain creates steam, yet a healthy flame can keep burning while wet. The cited entries directly support both halves.

candidates.premise: Charmander’s burning tail makes a sound, but only quiet places let you hear it.
candidates.hook: Charmander’s flame has a sound—if the world is quiet enough.
candidates.visualIdea: A noisy scene mutes the flame’s sound; the world fades silent and tiny crackles appear as waveforms.
candidates.note: Extremely distinctive and concise, with an excellent sound-design hook. It relies on one Pokédex entry, but that entry directly supports the entire premise.

candidates.premise: Charmander’s tail flame is its life meter: weak health means a weak flame, and extinction means death.
candidates.hook: Charmander carries its life bar on the end of its tail.
candidates.visualIdea: A glowing tail-flame HUD drains from bright to dim, ending on a dramatic flame-out warning.
candidates.note: A highly Charmander-specific survival rule with strong visual stakes, though the life-force idea is familiar to many fans.

candidates.premise: Charmander is born with its tail already burning, and that flame remains tied to whether it survives.
candidates.hook: Charmander is born with a flame that cannot go out.
candidates.visualIdea: A newborn silhouette reveals a lit tail, then the flame shifts from faint to brilliant like a vital sign.
candidates.note: Strong life-cycle framing, but the hook slightly overstates the evidence: the flame is said to burn from birth and death follows if it goes out, not that it categorically cannot go out.

candidates.premise: Charmander’s tail gives away its mood: it wavers in happiness but blazes fiercely in rage.
candidates.hook: You can read Charmander’s emotions from its tail.
candidates.visualIdea: Split-screen Charmander: a gently wavering happy flame versus an explosive rage blaze.
candidates.note: Clear and well-supported, but emotional flame behavior is a less surprising premise than the survival or sound details.

candidates.premise: Charmander evolves at level 16, then waits 20 more levels for Charizard—and the line finally gains Flying.
candidates.hook: Charmander’s line waits until level 36 to take flight.
candidates.visualIdea: A level counter races 16 to 36 as Charmander becomes Charmeleon, then Charizard bursts upward with Flying added.
candidates.note: The level gap and delayed Flying type are concrete and easy to animate, but the angle is mainly about the evolution line rather than Charmander itself.

rounds.request: The strongest angles are already supported. A still stronger version would add an official gameplay or animation example showing Charmander remaining lit in rain, but the Pokédex evidence is sufficient for this episode.
